description: Check a medicine's official US label warnings, recalls and most-reported adverse reactions. Looks up a brand or generic name in openFDA: label summary (ingredients, manufacturer, route, boxed warning, indications, warnings, interactions, pregnancy excerpts), recent recall enforcement reports and top FAERS adverse reactions with counts. FAERS reports do not prove causation. Not medical advice. Use when an agent needs citable FDA facts about a drug. $0.003 per call, USDC on Base (x402).

drug.description: Brand or generic drug name, e.g. Advil or ibuprofen
